One author, one model family, no independent reviewer. Recorded on the merge authority the founder gave in general terms, NOT as a satisfied gate. THE RESOLUTION WAS THE CHECK'S FIRST REAL EXERCISE. Six merges (#106, #99, #101, #102, #103, #104) took main 7f7bddd -> 3731087 and moved every figure this branch asserts. Every ci.yml hunk was a figure in the registry, so the conflict set and the registry were the same list. METHOD: resolved hunk by hunk keeping main's prose everywhere — never a whole-file take, which would have dropped this branch's own two steps out of ci.yml — and then ran the check BEFORE correcting anything. IT REPORTED 16 FINDINGS ACROSS 22 CHECKED: 14 mismatches and 2 unmatched. THE TWO UNMATCHED ARE THE FAIL-CLOSED RULE EARNING ITS PLACE: main had replaced the two grep -c recipes with a parseCiSteps derivation — the same argument this check makes, reached independently — so both locators matched nothing and the check said 'the prose moved and this figure is now UNCHECKED — re-aim the locator, never delete it' instead of passing over them in silence. Re-aimed at the new recipe and kept as TWO entries, because run-steps and guarded-steps are equal today and are not the same question. ONE FIGURE WAS ALREADY FALSE ON MAIN AND NOTHING OF MINE CAUSED IT: .github/workflows/ci.yml states '18 checks behind those 5 names' and 'They are 18 steps here' while the derivation at 3731087 gives 19 — check:memory gained test:eviction in the #103 merge. Verified against origin/main directly with git show, not against my merged tree, so the claim is about main and not about my resolution. That is exactly the class this check was built for, caught in the wild on its first outing. CROSS-CHECK: the three numbers I was handed for main were confirmed independently before being used — STEPS.length 44, ci.yml run steps 45, guarded 45, each derived through parseCiSteps on git show origin/main: copies. At the merged head they are 46, 47 and 47, plus aliasLinkTotal 19, ciRunStepsPlusOne 48. Every documented figure was corrected FROM THE DERIVATION, never from a number handed to me. THREE PROSE DEFECTS THE CHECK COULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT, fixed and reported because they mark the boundary of what was built: (1) origin/main stated as 7f7bddd and the tree named as feat/memory-eviction — both falsified by the merge train, the THIRD expiry of that line in one day, and neither a sha nor a branch name is a number the suite derives, so no version of this check can reach them; (2) 'the QA gate has never produced a verdict — .qa/ does not exist in the tree at all, not an empty directory, absent' — there are 19 verdict records on origin/main, so it was flatly false, and it is restated against what is actually still missing, the multi-judge panel, rather than against what has since arrived; (3) A SECOND STATEMENT OF THE FLOOR TALLY 230 lines above the one in the registry, stale at 44 while the check reported GREEN over it for a whole PR — the 'figures nobody wired' limitation demonstrated live rather than described. That one IS wireable and is now wired as status-floor-tally-summary; the other two are not. ALSO DECIDED HERE: main kept '~46 red steps' where this branch had deleted it as unassertable. Wiring beats both sides — guarding the setup steps would run every check plus the failed checkout, so it is exactly ciRunSteps + 1 and the tilde was hedging an exact quantity. Now derived as ciRunStepsPlusOne and asserted. RESIDUAL NOTED, NOT FIXED: main's new recipe filters with .filter(s=>s.run) (truthy) while this library uses s.run != null; they agree today and would diverge on a step carrying an empty run: value.
